part.text:
Fixed. The `-0`/`--nul-output` option was already wired into the option table (src/main.c:6404) and output logic (`RAW_NUL` handling in `process`), but `jq_cli_engine_isoptish` (src/main.c:5825) only accepted `-` followed by `--` or an alphabetic character, so `-0` was treated as the program name instead of an option — which caused `.[]` to be interpreted as an input file.

The fix adds `|| text[1] == '0'` to that check, making `-0` (including stacked forms like `-r0`) parse as the NUL-output option while `-0x` still correctly errors as an unknown option.

All test suites pass: `tests/shtest` (including the `-0`/`--nul-output` regression test), jq.test (362/362), man.test (199/199), optional, base64, utf8, and oniguruma tests.
